children: Archrock Inc. (AROC) filed a Form 8K - Entry Into a Definitive Agreement - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on November 10, 2026.

On November 10, 2026, Archrock Services, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership (the "Company") and wholly owned subsidiary of Archrock, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("Archrock"), entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the "Merger Agreement") by and among the Company, Project Avengers 2026 Merger Sub, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company ("Merger Sub"), HiVolt Energy Holdings, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company ("HiVolt"), and Shareholder Representative Services LLC, a Colorado limited liability company, solely in its capacity as the unitholders' representative. Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, Merger Sub will merge with and into HiVolt (the "Merger"), with HiVolt continuing as the surviving company and a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company. The respective boards of managers (or equivalent governing authorities) of the Company, Merger Sub and HiVolt unanimously approved the Merger Agreement and the transactions contemplated thereby, including the Merger, and determined that they were advisable and in the best interests of their respective equity holders.

Upon the terms and subject to the conditions of the Merger Agreement, at the effective time of the Merger, the outstanding Class A units and Class B units (the "Units") of HiVolt (other than any Units held in treasury) will be converted into the right to receive cash consideration, without interest. The aggregate merger consideration is based on a purchase price of $415 million, subject to adjustments for net working capital, indebtedness, cash, unpaid transaction expenses, certain capital expenditure adjustments and certain scheduled items, as provided in the Merger Agreement.

In connection with the Merger and pursuant to the terms of the Merger Agreement, the Company adopted an incentive plan to facilitate the earnout under which selected employees of HiVolt may earn cash incentive payments with respect to fiscal years 2027 through 2029 of up to $35.0 million in the aggregate. Amounts payable under the incentive plan to any participant for the applicable fiscal year are tied to the adjusted gross margin performance of HiVolt's business and the individual's bonus participation percentage. Any amounts earned for fiscal years 2027 through 2029 will be paid in July 2028, 2029 and 2030, respectively, subject to the participant's continued employment through the payment date (subject to protections in the event of a participant's termination without cause, for good reason or by reason of death or disability). Any amounts paid under the incentive plan are expected to be recorded as compensation expense in the Company's financial statements.

The Merger is expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of customary closing conditions, including, among other things: (i) the absence of any governmental order or applicable law prohibiting or making illegal the consummation of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement; (ii) the Company's and HiVolt's performance, in all material respects, of their respective obligations under the Merger Agreement required to be performed at or before the closing of the Merger (the "Closing"); (iii) subject to the standards specified in the Merger Agreement, the accuracy of the Company's and HiVolt's respective representations and warranties; (iv) receipt of required approvals and expiration or termination of applicable waiting periods under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended; (v) delivery of the required closing certificates and other closing deliverables; and (vi) solely as conditions to the Company's obligation to consummate the Merger, the absence of a Material Adverse Effect (as defined in the Merger Agreement) with respect to HiVolt since the date of the Merger Agreement that is continuing as of the Closing, and the execution, delivery and effectiveness of certain employment arrangements, restrictive covenant agreement and subscription agreements by certain key employees of HiVolt prior to Closing.

The Merger Agreement contains customary representations, warranties and covenants, including covenants relating to (i) the conduct of HiVolt's and its subsidiaries' businesses prior to the Closing or earlier termination of the Merger Agreement, including ordinary-course operations and preservation of material third-party relationships, subject to specified exceptions, and (ii) the parties' efforts to complete the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement, including obtaining required regulatory approvals and third-party consents.

The Merger Agreement may be terminated prior to the Closing, subject to certain exceptions, (i) by mutual written consent of the parties; (ii) if the Closing has not occurred by 120 days after the date of the Merger Agreement (subject to extension as provided in the Merger Agreement, the "Outside Date"); (iii) if a final, non-appealable governmental order or applicable law permanently prohibits or makes illegal the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement; (iv) for certain breaches of representations, warranties or covenants that would cause a closing condition not to be satisfied, subject, if curable, to a cure period of up to 30 days following notice or, if earlier, the Outside Date; or (v) by HiVolt or its unitholders' representative in certain circumstances if the Company fails to consummate the Closing when required. The Merger Agreement preserves certain rights and remedies following termination, including for willful breach or actual fraud.

The foregoing description of the Merger Agreement does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the complete text of the Merger Agreement, a copy of which is filed as Exhibit 2.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K (this "Current Report") and is incorporated by reference herein. The Merger Agreement has been included to provide investors with information regarding its terms. It is not intended to provide any other factual information about the Company, Merger Sub, HiVolt or the unitholders' representative. The representations, warranties and covenants contained in the Merger Agreement were made only for purposes of the Merger Agreement as of the specific dates therein, were solely for the benefit of the parties to the Merger Agreement, may be subject to limitations agreed upon by the contracting parties, including being qualified by confidential disclosures made for the purposes of allocating contractual risk between the parties to the Merger Agreement instead of establishing these matters as facts, and may be subject to standards of materiality applicable to the contracting parties that differ from those applicable to investors. Investors are not third-party beneficiaries under the Merger Agreement and should not rely on the representations, warranties and covenants or any descriptions thereof as characterizations of the actual state of facts or condition of the parties thereto or any of their respective subsidiaries or affiliates. Moreover, information concerning the subject matter of representations and warranties may change after the date of the Merger Agreement, which subsequent information may or may not be fully reflected in Archrock's public disclosures.
